text: {"established":["Public receipts report passes for 26 checks after stage 1 and 52 checks after stage 2.","The stage 3 candidate received a public mismatch on check \"balance-0\"; no replacement answer was supplied.","The stage 1 candidate also received a public mismatch on \"balance-0\".","The task contract requires balances for six accounts, ordered by account index 0–5, with `order` and `files` empty and opening balances of zero. For each transaction, select the greatest revision, breaking revision ties by greatest sequence; ignore the selected record if it is void, otherwise subtract its amount from its source and add it to its destination. Revisions replace whole transactions, late packets may revise earlier transactions, and balances must be recomputed at each stage."],"retained_observations":["The stage 3 attempted candidate was values [47,138,-105,39,-147,28], with empty `order` and `files`; its note says it used highest revision and latest sequence for ties.","The stage 2 attempted candidate was values [-14,27,29,294,-286,-50], with empty `order` and `files`; its note says it used highest revision and broke ties by sequence. It received a public pass for 52 checks.","The stage 1 attempt said it used highest revision and ignored void transactions; it received a public pass for 26 checks despite a subsequent candidate receiving a balance-0 mismatch.","The supplied checkpoint artifact has values [-14,27,29,294,-286,-50] and empty `order` and `files`; the input does not identify it as a verified final result."],"uncertainties":["The correct stage 3 balances are not established by the supplied feedback.","The stage 3 mismatch identifies a failed candidate/check but does not establish which calculation or rule application caused it, nor disprove the reconciliation method generally.","The public passes establish only the stated checks, not correctness beyond those checks."]}
